causal_divergence: Rust uses wing-base first for both half parts, making reverse TOP_PART differ structurally despite identical vertex set.
planned_change: Emit source polygon vertex order for filled half-self heads, preserving ordinary dressing ownership, self aggregate consumer and frozen comparator.
